title: astragalus rubromarginatus subsp. oeroilanicus
intro: Astragalus rubromarginatus subsp. oeroilanicus, commonly known as a type of legume, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. This plant is valued for its traditional use in medicine and is known to offer various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus rubromarginatus subsp. oeroilanicus include its potential in improving cardiovascular health, reducing stress, and enhancing immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
